definitions.ask: Should Ctrl+9 also open today's daily note when the active tab has no Markdown editor (empty tab, PDF, canvas)?
definitions.why: Matches Ctrl+0, and a pinned daily tab helps most when the current tab is not a note.

choices.label: Ctrl+9 finds the pinned daily tab from any tab, as Ctrl+0 already does
Ctrl+9 still shows "No active markdown editor" outside Markdown tabs
